test_title: PYST 7: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

People put considerably many more effort when working in groups than when working alone.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the phrase 'considerably many more' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **'considerably more'** as **'effort' **is a**n uncountable noun** and does not take 'many'.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be 'considerably more effort'.

Hence, the correct statement is '***People put considerably more__ effort when working in groups than when working alone*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When using uncountable nouns, phrases like **'much more'** or **'considerably more'** are appropriate.
 
• For countable nouns, phrases like **'many more'** are used.
 
 
• There ar**e many more days l**eft for me to legally become an adult.
